name: Volume Ray Casting and Clipping
definition: A two-pass ray tracing approach for volume rendering that allows for arbitrarily many overlapping clip regions with arbitrary geometry types. The first pass assembles clip intervals by intersecting viewing rays with clip objects, and the second pass integrates volume density while respecting these intervals.
summary: Volume Ray Casting and Clipping is a two-pass technique that assembles clip intervals using surface normals to exclude specific volume regions, handling complex concavities unlike standard ray casting.
